test_title: PYST 7: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 11 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which option is correct regarding the abbreviation, full form and its primary function?

options.text: LAN - Local Area Network connects computers within a limited area.
CD - Central Disk Operating System permanently stores
ASCII - American Standard Communication for Input and Interface used for graphic design -
ASCII - Advanced System for Communication Interface - used in LAN setup

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **LAN - Local Area Network:**

 
 
• A **Local Area Network (LAN)** connects computers and devices within a limited geographical area such as a home, office, or campus.
 
• It allows devices to communicate and share data, resources, and applications efficiently.
 
• LANs typically use Ethernet cables, Wi-Fi, or other technologies for connectivity. *Hence, this statement is correct.*
 
 
 
• **CD - Central Disk Operating System:**
 
 
• This option is incorrect as **CD** commonly refers to **Compact Disc**, a medium used for storing digital data such as music, software, and other files, not a Central Disk Operating System.
 
• Its primary function is to provide read-only or writable data storage.
 
• The statement about CD being related to a disk operating system is incorrect. *Hence, this statement is incorrect.*
 
 
 
• **ASCII - American Standard Communication for Input and Interface:**
 
 
• **ASCII** stands for **American Standard Code for Information Interchange**, not for communication input and interface.
 
• Its primary function is to represent text and control characters in computers and electronic devices.
 
• It is not related to graphic design. *Hence, this statement is incorrect.*
 
 
 
• **ASCII - Advanced System for Communication Interface:**
 
 
• As mentioned above, **ASCII** represents text characters through numerical codes and is not related to LAN setup or communication interfaces.
 
• Its primary function is to standardize text representation across devices. *Hence, this statement is incorrect.*
 
 
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Option 1.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Local Area Network (LAN):**

 
 
• A **LAN** is typically used in environments such as homes, schools, and businesses to connect computers within a small area.
 
• It enables resource sharing, including internet access, printers, and files.
 
• Common technologies used in LANs include **Ethernet** and **Wi-Fi**.
 
• LANs are faster and more secure compared to wide-area networks (WANs).
 
 
 
• **Compact Disc (CD):**
 
 
• A **Compact Disc** is a digital optical disc used primarily for data storage and distribution.
 
• It was introduced by **Philips** and **Sony** in **1982**.
 
• Uses include storing music, software, and multimedia content.
 
• CDs are largely replaced by modern storage formats such as USB drives and cloud storage.
 
 
 
• **ASCII:**
 
 
• **ASCII** is widely used in programming and data processing to represent text characters in computers.
 
• It uses a **7-bit binary code** to represent 128 characters, including English alphabets, digits, and control characters.
 
• ASCII was developed in **1963** by the **American National Standards Institute (ANSI)**.
 
• Examples of ASCII codes include **65** for 'A', **97** for 'a', and **48** for '0'.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **LAN Features:**

 
 
• Provides high-speed connectivity within a localized area.
 
• Supports multiple devices, enabling efficient communication and resource sharing.
 
• Typically inexpensive compared to other networks like WAN.
 
 
 
• **ASCII Advantages:**
 
 
• Ensures compatibility between different computer systems.
 
• Standardized text representation helps in programming and data processing.
 
 
 
• **CD Characteristics:**
 
 
• Offers high data durability and low cost.
 
• Commonly used for archival purposes and software distribution.
